data.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts, definitely not a factory loading.  Flechettes won't pattern as well as normal shot, and they'll likely do less damage.  However, they may fare better against armor than other shotgun loads.

This antiquated single shot pistol would complete a pirate's outfit nicely.  While its loading may be slow, it does not require brass casings to fire, and is theoretically sustainable.  Range and accuracy are hampered by lack of rifling, but this old design is still plenty lethal.

This is an old revolver designed during the period of westward expansion.  Black powder paper cartridges must be loaded for each shot, which is a fairly lengthy process.  Despite its age, this type of weapon would perform adequately against most two-legged threats.

An antique design, this smoothbore long arm would look more at home on a pre-1850's battlefield than in your hands in the cataclysm.  Its loading may be slow, but it does not require brass casings to fire, and is theoretically sustainable to fire.  Range and accuracy are hampered by lack of rifling, but this time-tested design is plenty lethal.

An older single shot grenade launcher, looking something like a sawn off shotgun.  Though it's mostly been replaced by underbarrel launchers, dedicated models like this have seen use by law enforcement and riot personnel.  Still deadly against hard or soft targets, depending on what cartridges are available.

This large, clumsy looking launcher looks like the offspring of a machine gun and a mortar; its bore is huge, and its action is just as massive.  A huge belt of grenade cartridges loads into its tray, allowing several grenades to be launched in rapid succession.  If one grenade fired from this isn't enough to solve your problems, surely a dozen more are.  This must be mounted on a frame to be fired, and reloading is a bit slow.

data.//: more like granadepistole
data.description: A stubby single shot pistol with a large bore barrel, suitable for launching grenades or flares.  This is a slightly more convenient way to transport a grenade launcher than mounted to one's rifle, a practice more common among special forces.  In more recent years, variants were sold commercially to ostensibly launch flares.  With the right cartridges, this would be devastating against hard or soft targets.  This could be attached to a suitable rifle, if so desired.

use_action.msg: You make the launcher ready for attachment.

data.description: Looking something like a large revolver from a cartoon this launcher is capable of firing six grenades in rapid succession.  Its huge cylinder is wound by a clock spring, which hastens firing, but slows reloading, as it must be re-wound.  Needless to say, six well placed shots is an incredible amount of firepower, depending on the cartridges loaded.

Since the early days of western expansion, when ammunition supply was infrequent, shooters sought to share ammo between their sidearms and long arms.  This tube magazine lever-action carbine allows the shooter to reduce the number of calibers carried and squeeze more power from their pistol ammunition.

This pistol is a tiny machinegun you can stuff into a holster, with which you could dump its magazine at a blistering rate into any close range foes.  Machine pistols mostly see use by vehicle crewmen or bodyguards of VIPs.  Due to its preposterous rate of fire it is difficult to control.

A modern pistol fit for duty, military service, or personal defense, with a detachable box magazine and a reliable action.  Though its chambering is capable of meeting FBI penetration minimums, the lack of a shoulder stock limits its utility.

data.name: survivalist carbine
data.description: These small carbines share ammunition and magazines with common pistols, offering a more controllable carbine than a normal rifle, while also reducing ammunition costs.  Because of their compatibility, they pair well with duty pistols, allowing one to transition to a more stable weapon without carrying extra ammo or magazines.

Revolvers like this, chambered for standard defensive calibers, were a favorite of police departments for nearly a century, up until the 1986 Miami shootout.  Afterwards, the slow reloading and shooting of revolvers were considered liabilities; still, this model's accuracy and moderate recoil make for a serviceable sidearm, and there are no magazines for you to lose or damage.

data.name: submachine gun
data.description: Chambered in common pistol ammunition, this compact long arm is perfect for trench raiders, vehicular crewmen, SWAT teams and special forces.  Though not as accurate as a proper rifle, especially at longer ranges, it is very controllable in automatic fire.  It feeds from detachable box magazines, which are easy to unload into close range targets.

data.name: survivor subgun
data.description: A crudely constructed fully automatic submachinegun, accepting standard pistol and submachine gun magazines.  The heavy bolt makes accurate fire difficult, and its questionable construction makes for poor reliability and longevity.  Similar designs of desperation from the Second World War served their nations well enough, so this should be good for zombies… right?  Accepts standard pistol ammunition.
A poorly maintained and inaccurate version of the M9 for feral security guards, feral preppers, etc.

This large pistol is almost as heavy as a small carbine, and just about as powerful too.  Chambered in hard hitting magnum calibers, it is suitable for hunting medium game, humans, or offsetting any of one's perceived deficiencies.  Though traditionally such magnums are revolvers, this one is a magazine fed semi-automatic.
data.//: We're just going to pretend that .357 and .44 magnum deagles will run .38's and .44 special just fine

data.description: A modern re-imagining of the classic western lever-action, this larger rifle accepts powerful magnum pistol ammunition as well as weaker pistol ammo.  Carrying this along side a magnum pistol would allow one to reduce the number of calibers carried, and allow you to squeeze more power from ammunition.

A crudely constructed carbine, chambered for magnum pistol ammo and standard pistol ammo.  It feeds from commercial magnum pistol magazines, and locks with a rudimentary lever-action system.  Its powerful cartridge and relative precision should serve well against zombies and medium game.

A firearm made from a stout pipe, reinforced at the chamber.  It holds a single a round of standard or magnum pistol ammunition, and has a crude assembly to fire it.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction makes for poor reliability and longevity.

Early handgun hunters helped develop this revolver's magnum ammunition from standard calibers, which needed heavier revolvers to safely fire it.  These revolvers' cylinders can thus chamber both magnum and standard pistol ammunition.  You could take medium to large game with this hefty piece.

With near non-existent recoil and inexpensive ammunition, rifles like this one are popular introductory firearms.  It has a built in magazine, capable of holding an impressive amount of its small cartridges.  You could take small game with this, but anything bigger might not even notice.

data.name: target pistol
data.description: This medium sized pistol fires cheap and plentiful plinking ammo, and is exceptionally popular for practice or target shooting.  This pistol is unsuited for taking on anything but small game, as it is meant to poke holes in paper.  Accepts box magazines.

data.name: zip gun
data.description: A crude single shot firearm made from improvised or homemade components, chambered for tiny plinking ammunition.  Zip guns like these often turned up in the hands of criminals and insurgents.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction leaves its longevity in question.
A cheap varmint air rifle chambered in .177, suitable for hunting small game.

The products of decades of improvement, rifle such as this are handy, reliable, and adaptable.  An 'assault rifle', it is capable of providing both accurate semi-automatic fire and bursts of automatic fire.  Short of large creatures and light vehicles, this should take care of most of your problems out to several hundred meters.

The light machine gun is a formidable implement for suppressive fire, an important part of squad tactics.  Its belt feed allows for hundreds of rounds to be loaded, and its heavy components can withstand long bursts of fire.  While perhaps not as precise as a service rifle, a light machinegun does allow for a considerable amount of energy to be sent down range.  Slow to reload.

data.name: sniper rifle
data.description: Sniper rifles fill military, police and civilian needs for precise, accurate fire.  Modern examples feature detachable magazines and various mounting interfaces for optics and supports.  With care and practice, all should be quite capable of eliminating bipedal threats from very safe ranges.

data.name: sporter carbine
data.description: Though often mislabeled an assault rifle, this common, cheap magazine fed carbine isn't capable of automatic fire.  While almost as effective as a proper rifle, the wider variety of components and varying levels of maintenance make these less reliable than their military brethren.  These rifles are just as adequate for taking on anything smaller than large game, however.

A battle rifle popular among the Exodii.  Reliable and powerful, though slightly unwieldy to use as an infantry weapon.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.

data.name: foreign sniper rifle
data.description: A sniper rifle popular among the Exodii.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.

data.name: railgun rifle
data.description: A handheld railgun which magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS.

data.name: combination rifle shotgun
data.description: A break action firearm comprised of a rifle barrel over two smooth bore shotgun barrels.  Historically used by egomaniac hunters in Africa, now used by their egomaniac descendants in New England.
A fake semi-auto rifle for feral militiamen (because monster aiming is too lethal).

Large, intimidating, and overbuilt, this hefty rifle fires huge projectiles with relative precision.  Though it resembles a sniper rifle, this anti-material weapon is best suited for blinding tanks, shooting at aircraft, or destroying explosives.  It feeds from comically oversized magazines.

Elegantly engraved, with deep glossy blued steel and figured wood, this break-action double rifle is almost too nice to shoot.  Your shoulder might beg you not to; the chambers are almost wide enough for two fingers and the recoil is monstrous.  You could probably kill anything with this, especially if you were to fire both barrels at once.

This large, ungainly  belt-fed machine gun fires huge projectiles, originally intended for turn of the century anti-vehicular use.  While no longer suitable for modern tanks or aircraft, thinner skinned vehicles or drones are just as susceptible, as are any other 'smaller' threats.  Slow to reload, incredibly loud, and must be mounted to be fired.

Constructed of fiberglass, with crude plastic sights and a titanium barrel, this is a launcher for a single rocket.  Though not as effective as other anti-armor weapons, the true value in this disposable rocket launcher is its portability and lack of dead weight once expended.  Has a backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.

This heavy, gigantic rifled tube features a complex optical sight and can launch a wide variety of payloads, including rockets or laser guided missiles.  Depending on the warhead loaded, such weapons are effective against older tanks, most vehicles, bunkers and personnel.  These are meant to be operated by a two-man crew, so reloading might be a bit slow.  Its recoilless design allows for superior range and damage, but it produces tremendous backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.

An old-fashioned double barreled shotgun, with a trigger for each barrel.  Follow up shots are incredibly quick with this, but reloading is a bit slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

A crudely handmade double barreled shotgun, with a trigger for each barrel.  Follow up shots are incredibly quick with this, but reloading is slow, as there are no extractors or ejectors.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: sporting shotgun
data.description: A simple, popular design, sporting shotguns are used by law enforcement, civilians and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small by modern standards, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: short shotgun
data.description: A simple, shotgun without a stock used by law enforcement and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: tactical shotgun
data.description: A detachable magazine fed shotgun, mostly oriented towards overly enthusiastic civilians.  Featuring rails and a menacing black appearance, this sort of shotgun doesn't really look like it has a sporting use.  The magazines reduce lengthy reloading times associated with shotguns.  Though known for being somewhat finicky, these can be tuned to run with some reliability.
A crude shotgun, composed of two thick steel pipes, an end cap and a nail.  The lack of sights make this weapon only useful at point-blank range.
A crude shotgun, composed of two thick steel pipes, an end cap and a nail.  The lack of sights make this weapon only useful at point-blank range.
Small shotgun, assembled from underbarrel shotgun modification and a pistol grip.  Not the best weapon, but has a really small size and weight.
A fake shotgun for feral bikers (because monster aiming is too lethal).

These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' is not the same as 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the cataclysm, massive stockrooms of the things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not so mobile anymore.

A prosthetic arm, used as a replacement limb for those missing one. A prosthetic arm, used as a replacement limb for those missing one.  Dating back to the Middle Ages and Rennaisance, this metallic arm was the cutting edge replacement of its day. As a künstler, you are trained to stay in your target's blind spot.

+1 dodge attempt, Dodging skill increased by 15% of Perception.

static_buffs.name: Seinerweisen
static_buffs.description:
"Personal Wisdom"
Through your mastery of Panzer Kunst, you have earned the ability to manipulate deadly plasma into all of your attacks!

Electric damage equal to 50% of Perception.

ondodge_buffs.name: Einzug Rüstungen
ondodge_buffs.description:
"Armor Penetration"
By attuning to the rhythm of your opponent, you can strike where their guard is the weakest.

+1 accuracy, armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 3 turns.

data.description: Pokken or "Pocket Fist" is a strange martial art developed from the famous Pokémon video game series.  Somehow, a group of dedicated fans managed to combine the moves used by various Pokémon with multiple existing martial arts such as boxing and karate.  Amazingly, it actually works.  Some might even say it's a super effective way to fight.
initiate: You get ready to battle.
%s is about to challenge someone to a battle.

oncrit_buffs.name: Sniper
oncrit_buffs.description:
Powers up your techniques after you score a critical hit.

+50% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

ongethit_buffs.name: Stamina
ongethit_buffs.description:
Boosts your defense after you get hit.

Bash, cut, and stab armor increased by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 3 turns.

onkill_buffs.name: Moxie
onkill_buffs.description:
Boosts your damage after defeating an opponent.

+50% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.

data.description: The Setting Sun discipline teaches its initiates to turn their opponents' advantages into disadvantages.  Students of this discipline are able to able to fool their opponents and then turn their strength against them with a powerful throw.
initiate: You shift your weight and prepare to defend yourself.
%s shifts their weight and assumes a new stance.

onblock_buffs.name: Fool's Strike
onblock_buffs.description:
You moved in such a deceptive way that you have turned your opponent's attack against them.

+20% damage.
Lasts 2 turns.

ondodge_buffs.name: Feigned Opening
ondodge_buffs.description:
By faking an opening, you able to throw your opponent off balance and act quicker for a short time.

+20 speed.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Baffling Defense
onpause_buffs.description:
You ready yourself for your opponent attack while preparing to send them flying!

Dodging skill increased by 20% of Intelligence.
Enables "Mighty Throw" and "Ballista Throw" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: Shii-Cho, "The way of the Sarlacc" was the first form lightsaber combat developed by the Jedi during their transition from metal weaponry to lightsabers.  Shii-Cho is regarded as a training form that all Jedi learn to understand the basics of armed combat.  Shii-Cho excels at fighting against groups but lacks the offensive power of the other lightsaber forms.
initiate: You place one foot back and hold your weapon vertically on your dominant side.
%s places one foot back and hold their weapon vertically.

static_buffs.name: Determination
static_buffs.description:
You are a determined warrior.  Your inner calm aids you in landing your strikes and protecting yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Strength, +1 accuracy.

static_buffs.name: Apprentice Training
static_buffs.description:
Your training in Shii-Cho teaches you how to combat multiple opponents.

+1 block attempt, +1 blocking effectiveness.

static_buffs.name: Knight Training
static_buffs.description:
Further training in Shii-Cho improves your ability to combat multiple opponents.

+1 block attempt, +1 blocking effectiveness.

static_buffs.name: Master Training
static_buffs.description:
As a master of Shii-Cho, your ability to fight against groups is second to none.

+1 block attempt, +1 blocking effectiveness.

onblock_buffs.name: Flowing Water
onblock_buffs.description:
You are able to deflect an attack and counter in the same motion.

-25% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: Strength, endurance, and patience are the cornerstones of the Stone Dragon discipline.  Stone Dragon students are taught to end battles with a single, powerful blow.  By standing still for a moment, the user can fortify themselves with the power of stone.
initiate: You dig your heels into the ground and steady yourself.
%s digs their heels into the ground.

static_buffs.name: Stonefoot Stance
static_buffs.description:
You maintain a steady stance that improves your combat prowess.  However, moving too much will break your stance.

+10% damage, +2 bash, cut, and stab armor.

oncrit_buffs.name: Iron Bones
oncrit_buffs.description:
With a powerful strike, you further fortify yourself again counterattacks!

+5 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 1 turn.

onhit_buffs.name: Stone Bones
onhit_buffs.description:
Each attack against your opponents slowly steels your defenses.

+1 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 5 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Cracked Stone
onmove_buffs.description:
Moving too much will negate the effects of Surefoot Stance.  Stay still to avoid shattering your stance!

Enables "Shattered Stone" buff.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmove_buffs.name: Shattered Stone
onmove_buffs.description:
You are unable to maintain your Surefoot Stance and must stop moving for a short time to regain its benefits.

-10% damage, -2 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: The Tiger Claw discipline embraces the fury and power of a wild beast.  Attacks from a Tiger Claw student are vicious and very few can stand against the might of a frenzied animal.
initiate: You emit a low growl as you prepare for battle.
%s hunkers down like a wild animal.

static_buffs.name: Improved Critical
static_buffs.description:
Always strike with full force.  Never hold back anything unless you want to die.

+5% critical hit chance.

oncrit_buffs.name: Blood In The Water
oncrit_buffs.description:
The scent of blood is near.  You want more.  NOW!

+1 accuracy, +15% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.

ongethit_buffs.name: Cornered Predator
ongethit_buffs.description:
A cornered animal is a terrifying and dangerous creature.  You are no different.

-20% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

onkill_buffs.name: Prey on the Weak
onkill_buffs.description:
You have started culling the herd.  It should be easier remove the rest now.

+30 speed.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Pounching Charge
onmove_buffs.description:
You recklessly throw yourself into battle to overpower your prey.  Strike first and strike hard.

+2 accuracy, +10% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.
You have lingering memories of training to fight cyborgs and war machines in zero gravity using the obscure Panzer Kunst.
The ancient arts of drunken brawling come naturally to you!  While under the influence of alcohol, your melee skill will rise considerably, especially unarmed combat.
You have studied the deeds and legends of ancient heroes.  From your research, you have learned an ancient form of combat called Hylian Swordsmanship.
Who needs weapons?  You deal more melee damage while your hands are empty.  This damage improves as your unarmed skill increases.
You are trained in the ways of the Jedi.  Your knowledge allows you to utilize a form of lightsaber combat.
You are well versed in the monstrous Pocket Fist martial art.  Train well, because it is your destiny to be a master.
You are a martial adept and learned one of the martial disciplines of the Sublime Way.  You start with your choice of Desert Wind, Diamond Mind, Iron Heart, Setting Sun, Stone Dragon, or Tiger Claw.

data.name: Bleed
data.description: With a shout and a gesture, the target starts bleeding from old wounds.
This spell links your living blood to dead blood and bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.

This spell links your living blood to dead blood and bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

data.name: Rupture

data.name: Weighting
data.description: Fill yourself with the power of Earth, and make each your attacks as devastating as an earthquake.

data.name: Crystal Wrapping
data.description: You cover your body with a layer of small, razor-sharp crystals.  It makes monsters that attack you take some damage in return, and gives you some additional cut damage in melee.

data.name: Crystal Wrapping Damage
data.description: Return some damage to attacker.  You can see it only in debug mode.

data.name: Shape of Dust
data.description: Hide yourself within sand-filled winds.  It's harder to hit you, and monsters can't spot you.
data.//: Fuck its broken. I thought you can make monster hard to see you, so you will be able to hide from them beyond the sand, but of course invis make monsters even more dumb, and they start to stoically ignore your existence.

data.name: Summon Earthshaper's Golem
data.description: Shape a strong golem out of stone.  It may help for a while, but you haven't enough energy to support it forever.

data.name: Summon Boulder
data.description: Pull the smooth rock underground, using your forces of earth shaping.  You can use it as a table, or as a primitive anvil.

data.name: Reading the Earthbones
data.description: You extend your senses into the ground, becoming aware of every hill and valley within a large area.  It will only work when in contact with the earth.

false_effect.u_message: Without a direct connection to the living earth, the spell fails.

data.name: Reading the Earthbones Real Spell
data.description: This is the spell that actually fires when you cast Reading the Earthbones.  It's a bug if you have it.
data.message: The secrets of the living earth are revealed to you.

data.name: Tremorsense
data.description: By sensing their movements upon the earth, you can detect nearby sources of danger.  You must maintain a connection to the earth for the spell to function.

false_effect.u_message: Without a direct connection to the living earth, the spell fails.

effect.u_message: As you break your connection to the living earth, your magical senses fade away.

data.name: Stones' Fortitude
data.description: Draw on the eternal endurance of the stones, slowing your metabolism and staving off hunger and thirst.  However, while the enchantment is in effect, you will not heal.

data.name: The Turning of the Earth
data.description: Ask the earth spirits to prepare the earth for growth and planting.

data.name: Granite Aegis
data.description: In an extremity of danger, summon a hollow shell of rock around yourself.  It lasts only a few moments, but sometimes that's all you need.  You must be standing on the living earth to invoke it.

false_effect.u_message: Without a connection to the living earth or a flat surface of solid rock, the spell fails.

data.name: Focused Bolt
data.description: You focus your mana into a microscopically thin pulsed beam of pure energy, capable of extreme range and precision; as well as unparalleled penetration, provided proper skill.  Once the invention of a notorious assassin, this spell has slain many a king and noble.  Passed on only through direct descendants over the ages, though occasionally shared by them to others.

data.name: Slowfall
data.description: Reduce the velocity of your falls by a great amount, or to zero if at high mastery.

data.name: Spider Climb
data.description: Ascend even the most sheer wall with ease as you cling to surfaces using the power of magic.

data.description: Mark a particular patch of ground to allow you to return to it later.

effect.u_message: As you make the gestures and recite the incantation, a brief glow fills your surroundings.

data.description: Immediately return to the place you marked with Magus's Mark, no matter how far away it is.

effect.u_message: You shout out the word of recall and suddenly you are somewhere else.

data.name: Crystallize Mana
data.description: Crystallizes mana into solid form.  Your physiological changes have made this spell much more efficient and easier to cast.

data.description: Fires bolts of mana from your fingertips that home in on randomly selected targets in range.
Sucks blood from one foe.

data.description: The go-to spell for many Stormshapers, this iconic spell does just what you expect: you shoot lightning from your fingertips.  However, this lightning is more directed than most lightning, and travels in a line through most non-solid targets.

data.name: Windstrike
data.description: A powerful blast of wind slams into anything in front of your body.

data.name: Windrunning
data.description: A magical wind pushes you forward as you move, easing your movements and increasing speed.

data.description: You fire a small concentrated ball of lightning at the target.  The electricity diffuses quickly, so it doesn't do much damage, but you're able to fire off several quick ones in a row.
You call the power of the sky to strike the earth.  Several lightning blasts fire from your finger tips to strike the target.

data.description: By manipulating the charge in the air, you can conjure a sharp snap of lightning over a wide area.  While its destructive potential is a far cry from natural lightning, the light and thunderclap produced will leave your foes reeling.

Blasts, generated by Electric Waves.

data.description: Summon a Teravolt, a small, semi-intelligent spirit that homes onto hostile creatures before exploding into a huge spark cloud.

data.name: Cloak of Fog Random

data.description: This spell stimulates the synapses in your brain beyond normal processing speeds, giving you a large boost in mental processing capability, including enhancing your reflexes, speed, and raw intellectual power.  Use responsibly!

data.name: Overcharge Burn
data.description: The side effects of casting the overcharge spell.

data.name: Optical Sneeze Beam
data.description: You overcharge your internal batteries to send a semi-directed beam from your face.  The inventor of this spell must have had some weird sense of humor.
data.message: You overcharge your bionic energy through what ley lines you have left, and channel it through the center of your face.

data.name: X-ray Vision
data.description: You fire a cone of X-rays that magically allows you to see that area for a short time.

data.name: Knock
data.description: You channel magic into a force capable of opening doors.  This variant can only open wooden doors.

data.name: Improved Knock
data.description: You channel magic into a force capable of opening doors.  This variant can open any locked door.

data.name: Knifeshot
data.description: This spell generates a magnetic field around a knife, before launching it at high speed.

data.name: Hypervelocity Knifeshot
data.description: This spell goes even further beyond, launching a knife so fast it can pierce through targets.

data.name: Shutdown
data.description: Overload the target, stunning it briefly.  Originally developed during the Roman Empire to target out-of-control golems, this spell became significantly more popular in modern times when it was discovered it also worked on robots and machinery.

data.name: Speak through the Aether
data.description: One of the most widely-known pre-modern technomantic spells, this allows technomancers to communicate at a distance.  Its use declined rapidly after Guglielmo Marconi invented the radio and suddenly everyone could listen in to their conversations.

data.name: Power Supply
data.description: For the technomancer with no enhancements, this spell summons a power supply composed of pure mana that can be used to charge any compatible device.  It will continually recharge until the duration expires.
data.//: The Power Supply provides 1 kj per second and regenerates 1 kj per second, so the duration is the total power supplied.  Cost below increases but not as fast as power does.

data.name: Voltaic Touch
data.description: Using the principles of what were once called "voltaic arcs", you can electrically heat metal hot enough to weld it together.

data.name: Dragons don't have nightmares, nightmares have dragons!
Journeyman Wizard
data.description: You have learned enough spells that in more reasonable times you would have graduated from your apprenticeship.

data.name: Archmage
data.description: You have learned a large number of spells, and would be qualified for the Archmage title.

data.name: Master Archmage
data.description: You have learned so many spells, that you would have been a major source of knowledge for many wizards.  Also known as a Sage, Master Archmages enjoy a wide variety of perks due to their lifelong commitment to learning and helping others learn.

data.name: Cast a Spell
data.description: The first great milestone to becoming a full-fledged wizard is to cast a spell.  Some mages simply study the spell in the spellbook until they think they understand it as well as they can, but you can't beat practice over theory.
Embedded into your back and connected to your bionic power supply is a powerful spell focus able to consume blood from dead creatures to produce bionic power.  It can store up to 750 mL of blood.
Internal tank for blood power generator bionic.

name: Restore Flesh and Bone
desc: Thanks to that apple, your wounds are slowly healing.
data.apply_message: Your flesh and bones start to knit together before your eyes.
data.remove_message: Your regeneration slows down.

name: Ward off Miasma
desc: No illness is going to get you down now.
data.apply_message: You feel revitalized.

name: Quick Blows
desc: Thanks to that pear, you can attack faster.
data.apply_message: You arms speed up.

name: Blackberry Thorns
desc: Anyone who attacks you will regret it.
data.apply_message: Long thorns grow through your skin, clothes, and armor.
data.remove_message: The thorns vanish without a trace, leaving your gear unharmed.

data.name: Blackberry fruit aura thorns
data.description: Stab a monster that attacked you.

name: Summer's Heat

data.remove_message: You shiver as a cool breeze hits your skin.

name: Ward off Toxins

name: Flexible

name: Root Impale

data.remove_message: The roots wither up and die.

data.remove_message: The aura of light distortion around you vanishes.

data.remove_message: The clouds of dust around you die down

name: Acidic burn

name: Scared

Terrified

data.name: Translocator Gate
data.description: A gate for translocation.  Cast the translocation spell or use a translocator to choose this gate as a destination.

data.name: Magic Circle
data.description: This is a rough magic circle, carved into the ground and decorated with blood, candles, and other small knick-knacks.

data.name: Magic Circle
data.description: This is a rough magic circle, carved into the ground and decorated with blood, candles, and other small knick-knacks.  It has been enhanced with silver to channel more mana.

data.name: large glowing boulder
data.description: Something about this doesn't look right.

data.name: enchanter's workbench
data.description: An ornate oak cabinet topped by a durable resin countertop resistant to most alchemical spills and burns.  It has wired in electrical and gas fittings, and has been decorated with several protection runes - mostly ornamental.

data.name: standing alembic
data.description: A large glass and copper alembic for distilling alchemical concoctions.  It consists of a copper pot with rising spires of twisted glass draining into various removable bottles.

data.name: orrery
data.description: This is a beautiful, non-scale model of the solar system.  A complex series of gears allows the relative motions of the planets to be studied at the turn of a crank.  This more modern version also has bluetooth and could have been controlled with an app, if there was any power anymore.

data.name: huge mana crystal
data.description: This is a mana crystal that juts from the ground as if it had sprouted up like a weed.  It pulses with a delicate yellow energy, occasionally bursting with flashes of pent-up light.

data.name: stone altar
data.description: This is a big stone altar.  Most commonly used in morally questionable rituals.

data.name: attunement altar
data.description: An ancient stone plinth covered in symbols that appear to be combinations and variations of the eight magic classes.  Eight depressions are on the top with the original symbols of the classes, each look as though they can hold an item.

data.name: demon forge
data.description: This is a forge made of the chitin of a huge, red spider that has a penchant for flames.  Custom made to withstand the heat from alumentum, this forge can resmelt the magical metals into their workable, ingot form.

data.name: demon forge
data.description: This is a forge made of the chitin of a huge, red spider that has a penchant for flames.  Custom made to withstand the heat from alumentum, this forge can resmelt the magical metals into their workable, ingot form.

data.name: candelabra of everlasting candles
data.description: A candelabra, strangely the candles never seem to burn down.  Smashing it doesn't seem like it'd produce any worthwhile salvage.

data.name: everfrost crystal
data.description: This massive mana crystal juts from the ground as if it had sprouted up like a weed.  It pulses with an angry white light, occasionally flickering brighter.

data.name: flat boulder
data.description: Smooth, flat boulder.  You can use it both as a table and an anvil.  It responds to your force, and you can easily move it.

bash.sound: The boulder recedes into the ground.

data.name: everburning torch candelabra
data.description: A candelabra made of a half-dozen everburning torches attached to a wooden support structure.  Plenty of light with no worries about power usage or smoke.  Plus, how can you be a real wizard unless your tower is lit by the flicking light of imperishable flames?

data.name: stone altar
data.description: An ancient stone altar, moss-grown and weather-worn.

data.name: standing stone
data.description: A tall standing stone.  It is covered in carvings, but they are so worn by wind and rain you can't make out what they might have been.

data.name: brambles
data.description: A thick wall of tangled brambles grows here.  Vicious thorns protrude from the stems.

data.name: platonic flower
data.description: Small bush, that looks like a pair of dragon curves, with a flower in the very center.  The branches of the plant can be used as a perfect ruler.

data.name: moonflower bush
data.description:
A silver colored vine, whose luminescent flowers will only bloom during night.

Amazingly rare, it grows only in places where heroic deeds took place, or so it's believed.

data.name: kampuch
data.description: The tiny and lethal rod flowers of the Kämpuch break the underbrush like small ivory thorns.

data.name: olieribos
data.description: Dark colored leaves and bitter roots, firmly entrenched in untrodden earth.  They can be used to ward against evil, or to attract it.

data.name: glowing mushrooms
data.description: A bioluminescent mushroom shaped like a small nest.  Motes of light occasionally detach from its surface and float upwards before fading.

data.name: horn moss
data.description: A cluster of red moss, so called for the white capsules that it will grow during spring.

data.name: golden reed
data.description: Thin stalks colored deep yellow, crowned with blue feather-like leaves.

data.name: barnacle weed
data.description: A wooden pod kept aloft by a spiral stalk and the short, dagger-shaped leaves growing at its base.

data.name: dragonails
data.description: A small tangle of old and crooked wood, completely covered with black menacing thorns.

data.name: moly
data.description: A small herb with milk white flowers and pitch black roots.  Known since Ancient Greece, it was brought to the New World by European druids long ago.

data.name: flowering fern
data.description: A seemingly normal fern, which has somehow produced a single red flower.

data.name: funnelcap
data.description: A man-sized mushroom, with most of its bulk defined by a tall funnel shaped pileus, which collects rainfall.

data.name: sojourner's palm
data.description: A large magical palm tree, normally you would find it in the tropics, but this plant also has the well documented ability to teleport randomly.

data.name: whiskflower bush
data.description: A small plant with curled leaves and pink whisk-shaped flowers.  It has a very strong alcoholic smell.

data.name: owlbear gastrolith
data.description: This strangely shaped rock was once a part of an owlbear's complex digestive system, creating a link between owl throat and bear stomach.  It is possible that it could serve a similar purpose in alchemy, helping to bind together two disparate halves.
data.//: In terms of alchemy the gastrolith could serve to combie different effects, such as safely mixing together potions, or it could be used as an element of change, such as for shapechanging potions.

data.name: stone shell
data.description: The broken fragment of an owlbear egg.  With luck it might still contain some of its former power, though if nothing else it's still a bit sharp.
data.//: Potion recipes that require a full owlbear egg could also instead require larger amounts of stone shell.  Since 1 egg gives 3 shells, you could perhaps have 1 egg be equivalent to 5 or more shells when making potions.

name.str_pl: copies of The Basics of Caster Levels

data.description: This book goes into details about different ways to boost one's caster level above what one would normally achieve.  Domination schools can be boosted by various items detailed inside, while harmony schools can be boosted by circumstances.  Regardless, the book cautions that this boost can not exceed 1 + ( your highest caster level in that school / 5 ).  For animist, they get a boost if they stand in blood.  More blood means a higher maximum boost.  Stormshapers gets a boost while being outside during precipitation.  More precipitation means a higher maximum boost.  Earthshapers get a boost by being underground, and by standing on dirt, sand, clay or the like.  Apparently, standing in pits is also very effective.  Druids gets a boost by standing on grass, fern, bushes, and the like.  Hugging a young tree gives among the highest possible boosts for druids.

This book is written in a runic language unfamiliar to you.  Fortunately, there are several very detailed pictures that demonstrate the process of forging a sword from an ingot of silvery metal.  You get the impression that this is some sort of textbook for blacksmiths.

data.description: This intricate contraption consists of fine gears, screw drivers, belts, pulleys, springs and other clockwork parts moving in a mesmerizing dance.  The gearwork is contained in a casing of magically treated glass and gives off a soft ticking noise.  An elegantly drawn magus rune in the center is being spun and rotated in a neverending complex dance of arcane energy.  The wind-up key extending from the casing slowly spins back into its original position.  You feel empowered, as your caster level of magus spells is boosted by 2.

use_action.msg: The device slows down and stops.

data.//: Based off of the candle, but twice the burn rate, and doesn't go out in the wind.
data.description: A thick candle of magically treated tallow with a kelvinist rune artfully inscribed on the side.  It doesn't burn for quite as long as a regular candle, but it will boost your caster level of kelvinist spells by 1 while burning.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the candle.

data.description: A thick candle of magically treated tallow with a kelvinist rune artfully inscribed on the side.  It doesn't burn for quite as long as a regular candle, but it will boost your caster level of kelvinist spells by 1 while burning.  The magic of the candle protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  This candle is lit.

use_action.msg: The candle winks out.

data.//: Based off of the clay oil lamp, but twice the burn rate, doesn't go out in the wind, and made of metal.
data.description: An masterfully crafted metal oil lamp with two elongated nozzles, each containing a wick.  The surface is carved with intricate arcane symbols, including a prominent kelvinist rune.  The magic of the lamp protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  It does not provide much light, but will boost your kelvinist caster level by 2 while burning.  Use it to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the lamp.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The lamp is empty.

data.description: An masterfully crafted metal oil lamp with two elongated nozzles, each containing a burning wick.  The surface is carved with intricate arcane symbols, including a prominent kelvinist rune.  The reflections from the flames makes it look like the inscriptions are moving.  The magic of the lamp protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  It is lit, consuming oil, boosting your kelvinist caster level by 2, and providing light.  Use it to extinguish the flame.

use_action.msg: The lamp is extinguished.

data.//: Stats are based off of a brick.
data.description: A fire-hardened clay tablet depicting a technomancer rune.  Breaking the tablet will release the stored magical energy, boosting your technomancer caster level by 1 for a while.

use_action.activation_message: You feel a surge of power as the clay tablet crumbles between your fingers.

data.//: Stats are based off of a food_processor.
data.description: A jumble of cables, gears, electromagnets, and metal encased in a steel casing inscribed with arcane runes.  A pebble with a technomancer rune is found at the core.  The machine can adjust the electric charge, magnetic field, and angular velocity of said rune.  When active and in your inventory, the machine will automatically detect when you are trying to cast a technomancer spell.  Once that happens, it will use a moderate amount of battery charge to boost your caster level as far as it can.  A larger boost will draw more energy.

use_action.msg: You turn on the doodad and it starts to hum.

data.//: Stats are based off of a food_processor.
data.description: A jumble of cables, gears, electromagnets, and metal encased in a steel casing inscribed with arcane runes.  A pebble with a technomancer rune is found at the core.  The machine can adjust the electric charge, magnetic field, and angular velocity of said rune.  While active and in your inventory, the machine will automatically detect when you are trying to cast a technomancer spell.  Once that happens, it will use a moderate amount of battery charge to boost your caster level as far as it can.  A larger boost will draw more energy.  A faint humming is heard from inside.

use_action.msg: The doodad shuts down.

data.//: based on a bone shiv.
data.description: A hollow bone, about 20 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a crude syringe.  A biomancer rune is carved on the surface.  By jabbing it into yourself, you can release stored biomancer booster sludge into yourself, thereby boosting your biomancer caster level by 1 for a while.  Doing so is about as painful as it sounds.

use_action.activation_message: You feel a surge of power as the bone syringe deposits the sludge inside your body.

data.//: based on a bone shiv.
data.description: An elegant, sturdy metal syringe with a biomancer rune carved on the outside.  It can be used to administer stored biomancer booster sludge into yourself, thereby boosting your biomancer caster level by 2 for a while.

use_action.activation_message: You feel a surge of power as the syringe deposits the sludge inside your body.

data.description: A thick purple liquid that is filled to the brim with arcane energy.  With the right tool, it can be used to boost your biomancer caster level.
This magical pebble has an insignia of rended flesh and bones on it.  It is necessary for Biomancers to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of clockwork and gears on it.  It is necessary for Technomancers to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of crystal and mana orbs on it.  It is necessary for Magi to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of steel and rocks on it.  It is necessary for Earthshapers to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of ice and flames on it.  It is necessary for Kelvinists to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of lightning and storm clouds on it.  It is necessary for Stormshapers to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of nature and trees on it.  It is necessary for Druids to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of summoners on it.  It is necessary for Animists to channel magic into their crafts.
This magical pebble has an insignia of alchemy and potions on it.  While versatile in use, the lack of attunement to any school prevents creation of more advanced recipes.

data.name: owlbear egg
data.description: This egg laid by an owlbear seems almost indistinguishable from a large rock until you touch it and can feel the warm glow of potential life energy from within.  It's hard to believe that an owlbear could grow so quickly from something so small.  Perhaps you could carefully crack it open to get at the liquid golden goodness inside.
data.//: Alchemically speaking, I see this egg as having the elements of Growth, Stone, and Egg.  Growth would make things grow faster, the simplest example being a magical liquid fertilizer.  Stone would be a defensive element, used in creating something like a potion of stoneskin.  Egg would be interesting though.  What if instead of being imbibed there were potions that instead functioned similarly to the sourdough items, or the blob vehicle parts, in that they take a gestation period and then you could activate them and have a new item pop out.  Creatures sure but especially biomancers could have temporarily-lived tools, weapons, and armor.
Normal whiskey has been greatly devalued in the apocalypse by the disproportionate quantity of endless whiskey flasks in comparison to the number of survivors.

data.name: owlbear egg yolk
data.description: The liquid innards of an owlbear egg.  Good eating.
A big, ugly ball of animal spit and licked-off hairs.  Don't swallow it.
The meat from a slain dragon.  It does not seem to respond to cooking the same way as other meat, making it obvious that it still retains some magical properties.
The mushrooms harvested from a dead shrieker.  Could be used in potions.

data.//: Same reason as whiskey

data.description: Indistinguishable from pre-Cataclysm lab grown beef.  It should be excellent but somehow it's just edible.
Not as tainted as previously and tastes like the real thing.  You do not want to cook this for your friends, though if you do they won't know the difference for a while.

data.name: golem core
data.description: The "heart" of a golem.  Makes a soft humming noise when you hold it close to your ear.

data.name: broken clay golem
data.description: A broken clay golem, looking like a piece of post-modern art.  Could be smashed for clay.

data.name: broken plastic golem
data.description: A broken plastic golem, like a giant action figure chewed up by an equally giant puppy.  You could smash it up into recycled plastic bits.

data.name: broken stone golem
data.description: A broken stone golem, not that much different from a big boulder.  Could be smashed for stone.

data.name: broken iron golem
data.description: A broken iron golem, with all iron you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for iron.

data.name: broken forge born
data.description: A broken forge born, with all orichalcum you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for orichalcum.

data.name: broken stone golem
data.description: A broken earthshaper's golem, almost the same as it's natural stone counterpart.  Could be smashed for stone.

This is a bag that can contain more than it should.  The bag magically reduces the weight of its contents and expands less than the amount of stuff you put into it.  It takes a few words and hand-waving to take an item out.
This dimensional bag has reached the limits of human innovation with a combination of manufacturing and magical secrets.
A box that uses gravity magic to preserve food.  It makes the box much heavier, but anything in it lasts far longer and you can store more.
Each of these mithril coins has a profile of Valzain, and strangely each of these coins is defaced in some way.
A simple carved staff, made of wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration
A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it increases your mana regeneration.

A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood and mithril.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it greatly increases your mana regeneration.

A sinister looking staff, made of wood and with a red orb of crystallized mana at the handle.  The orb and its rune faintly glow with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration and allows you to cast the bleed spell.

data.name: wizard hat
data.description: A blue pointed hat with stars stitched into it.  Wearing it increases your maximum mana.

data.name: fireball hammer
data.description: Use with caution!  Flammable!  Explosive!
This cloak seems to absorb light except for the pinpricks of stars that move across its surface.
This bag conjures a magical throwing knife on activation.  Only refills when worn.  It also boosts your throwing abilities.
data.//: the bag itself gives +3 to throwing instead of knifes because of stupid code oogie woogie, that make effects (and enchantments, it seems) being apply in the very first move after the giving. ie if you give +3 to throwing for a knife, spawn it, and then throw it, it wont be applied

data.description: A pair of silver cufflinks with a wolf's head engraved into them.  Each cufflink has a bright ruby eye and pearl teeth.  They appear to be growling.  There is an inscription, 'When the moon shines.  I become alive.'

data.name: magic leather belt
data.description: A leather belt.  Useful for making your pair of pants fit.
The mythical belt of Thor, god of thunder.  Or at least so it appears.  It doubles the wearer's base strength.
A sturdy workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold more than they should with a fair weight reduction.
A heavy-duty workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold far more than they should with a substantial weight reduction.
A wide girdle that fits around your waist, you can sheath or holster any weapon into it in the blink of an eye, and it seemingly stores them somewhere else.
A custom-built leather utility belt that instantly creates any tool that you reach for.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
A braided but flexible belt seemingly made of metal.  You can activate it to transform it into a whip and flay your enemies.

use_action.msg: You grab the belt and it uncoils to become a flexible metal whip in your hand!

data.description: A long braided flexible steel bullwhip that narrows into a sharp blade at the end.  Easily capable of slicing and dicing anything that comes at you.  It transforms back into a belt.

use_action.msg: You loop the whip in your hand and it coils back into a belt form in an instant.

data.description: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, they look like they've seen a lot of use and will likely see a lot more.  They make your movement a lot less work.
Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, they look like they've seen a lot of use and will likely see a lot more.  They make your movement a lot less work.

Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, these boots can be activated once a day to escape from nasty situations, teleporting you a good distance in a random direction.

Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, seeming a bit more flexible and breathable than typical for their materials.  The enchantment they bear helps guide their wearer in their motions, to make movement around and over obstacles much more fluid and efficient.
Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of leather with small engraved runes seemingly filled with rubber.  When worn, you are immune to damage from electricity.
A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.

A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  Wizards love to name it "Ultima Ratio", describing its colossal might.  Require almost a whole week to restore its charge.

A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  You don't really know how it works, but after use enemies literally freeze in the middle of their movement.  Require almost 7 days to restore its charge.

Known as "a worse version of petrification bracelet", this tool casts a spell that temporarily breaks the whole movement system of a creature, disabling its movement for a short time.  Require almost a week to restore its charge.

It feels like the world around you just stops.  That's not true, that's just a combination of really fast speed and some mana tricks you can't understand.  Requires a whole week to restore its charge.
A full assembly of medieval arm protection.
A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce damage you take.
A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce damage you take.

A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Jolt spell 3 times a day.

A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Lightning Bolt spell 3 times a day.
A magical cloak that shimmers like fresh water under a warm sun.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is excellent for swimming, but ill-suited for combat.

data.name: Wildshape Cloak: Bear
data.description: A magical cloak that smells of the forest.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is strong and resilient in melee combat.  However, you feel as if you would lose a part of yourself.

data.name: Wildshape Cloak: Deer
data.description: A magical cloak that feels soft to the touch.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form well-suited to escaping difficult situations.  However, it is not suited for combat.

A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.

A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.

data.name: parabolan wool blouse
data.description: A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.

A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.
A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and a few orichalcum threads sewn into the seams.  Perfect for the stylish-but-effective academic mage.

A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and orichalcum and mithril threads sewn into the seams.  A director of thaumaturgical research would have worn this or something like this before the Cataclysm.

data.//: Combination of the doubled best stats of the homemade & solvent trap suppressors w/ +1 enchantment & volume reduction to half
data.description: Rather than using purely wipe media, an additional localized silence spell in this tube quiets gunshots going through to hearing-safe levels.

A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit under the barrel.

use_action.msg: You rotate the laser sight.

data.description: A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit on the rail.

use_action.msg: You rotate the laser sight.

data.name: mana dot sight
data.description: Adds a blue dot optic made from crystallized mana to the top of your gun, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.

data.name: magic mask
data.description: A generic magic mask.
A mask with no facial features at all, just eye and mouth holes, upon activation it makes everything ignore your presence for a while.
A decidedly steampunk-looking half mask that covers the eye area of the face, it has large lenses that correct and greatly enhance the vision of the wearer.

data.//: Effectively a durable knife spear +1 with IMPALE tech.  based off Wicked Bonespear.  Lorewise, it would make sense for novice Biomancers to be developing their skills in spears so they can adequately use the Bonespear once they're proficient enough to summon one.  Should be weaker than other school weapons DPSwise due to reach.
data.description: A grotesque bone spearhead on a stout wooden pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded at the base of the head.

data.//: Effectively a durable knife spear +2 and a barb launcher that shoots sharpened bone, will have less dps because it has reach and is capable of morphing into a gun
data.description: A grotesque bone spearhead on a hardened flesh pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded in the middle.  You feel this spear squirming in your hand as if alive.

use_action.msg: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for ranged combat

data.//: Combat stats based off crowbar +1, techniques off Halligan bar(closest non-magical substitute), weight based on 16oz clawhammer head, small wrench and crowbar with a small benefit from being magic
data.description: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.

data.//: Pretty much the same as the other, but now with a cool touchscreen that casts mirror image and does some minor things
data.description: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There are electronic components in the staff connected to a touchscreen embedded in the staff, you only had time to cram one spell in the prototype software.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.

data.//: The classical vision of the wizard gets a classic weapon.  DPS Stats are between the regular and ironshod versions.  Stats are slightly worse than the QS+1 due to the glass weight slowing attack speed.
data.description: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two glass jars, heat-tempered and infused with mana for durability, to act as mana receptacles.  There are two Magi runes embedded at the tips.

data.//: It will be based on the Q +2 weapon but slightly worse, slightly better than the magus staff, but its greatest strength will be its regen mana capabilities, better than magi staff minor but worse than the lesser one.
data.description: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two mana pearls at the tip, enchanted with mana for durability.  It fills you with an invigorating sensation.  There are two Magi runes carved into the wood.

data.//: Flame-bladed sword covers half of Kelvinist's heat-cold theme.  Combat stats equivalent to cutlass +1 with BRUTAL technique.
data.description: A sword with an undulating blade, reminiscent of a flame.  There is a Kelvinist rune embedded in the pommel.

data.//: Stats based on scimitar +2, a weapon that will cast freezing touch when it hits, has wide strike
data.description: This curved sword, reminiscent of a scimitar, has a handle with an embedded crystal from which a cold wind emanates.  There are Kelvinist runes embedded in the blade.

data.//: Based off battle axe +1.  Metals chosen for being two most conductive metals + balancing reasons
data.description: A forged copper axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye.

data.//: There isn't an equivalent, so the damage has been multiplied by 1.2 to cutting and bashing
data.description: A forged copper hammer-axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye and a Nordic rune reminiscent of Thor, the thunder god, in the hammer side.

data.//: Tool qualities equivalent to steak knife, combat equiv.  to copper knife + 1 w/ RAPID and BLOCK1, size/weight off combat knife +1
data.description: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  Their school rune is embedded in the crossguard.

data.//: Tool qualities equivalent to combat knife with some saw capability, to represent sharpness, combat equiv.  to combat knife + 2 w/ RAPID and BLOCK1 with no to hit, size/weight off combat knife +1
data.description: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  The knife has seen so much bloodshed that the rune at the crossguard seemingly is constantly drenched in blood and gives you preternatural resistance to pain.
This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips retracted while in baton configuration.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You snap open your springstaff into staff mode.

data.description: This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips from retracting while in staff configuration.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You collapse your springstaff into baton mode.

data.//: Pretty similar to the war scythe, but with less weight, more cutting damage and capable of casting a strong offensive spell.
data.description: This is a long and crooked tool used to reap souls, with a skull engraved in its blade.  Magically treated to reduce weight and enhance sharpness, this enchanted weapon is even capable of delivering a strong rupture attack.  Let the harvest begin.

data.name: heat cube
data.description: A smooth steel cube the size of your fist.  Several buttons on the sides activate the powers of the cube.

use_action.msg: You push the torch button and the cube emits a large flame from the top, one that does radiate heat, but won't burn anything.

data.description: The heat cube in the torch configuration, where it emits warmth and a bright flame that does not burn.

use_action.msg: The torch flame is extinguished.

data.description: A small gold skeleton key.  You can activate it to unlock locked things.
This is a high quality engraved wooden torch.  On command, the tip bursts into flame and produces a fair amount of light.  It will burn forever.

use_action.msg: You light the torch.
The torch is extinguished.
You open the flask and discover it full of sweet, sweet, whiskey!

data.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

use_action.msg: You check the teapot and discover it full of sweet tea!  Sadly, it's cold.

data.name: enchanted tailor's kit
data.description: This is a high quality, engraved steel kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, even a small heating element for melting and joining plastic.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.  It also contains one of those magic spiders that constantly, if slowly, makes new thread.
This is a small glass box that contains a spider that diligently works day and night to produce silk thread that it stores in a reservoir you can open and retrieve it from.
A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.

data.//: Equivalent to composite bow for dispersion/reload/weight/range/encumb/bash, with two mod slots added equivalent to other weapons getting techniques
data.description: A bow made of multiple materials to maximize energy efficiency.  There are two Druid runes embedded at the tips.

A magically-enhanced update to the Phillips & Rodgers' M47 Medusa, a  multi-caliber revolver aimed at survivalists.  While Technomancy improves the reliability with smaller cartridges, it is not as accurate as dedicated caliber revolvers due to freebore.

name.str: Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine
name.str_pl: several Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine

data.description: These beautifully-made enchanted flintlock pistols were specially made for young noble scions in the Gardes de la Marine.  They still exist today as unspeakably-rare heirlooms that remain combat-worthy due to their magical nature.

data.name: gunblade
data.description: Constructed similarly to a falcata, this forward-sloping blade has a short-barrel pump shotgun attached to the blade's spine for finishing blows or a first strike.
A modernized version of the Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 by Cannith Industries, chambered in 7.62x51 NATO.  The barrel is enchanted to give bullets a minor freezing property.

Once a flesh spear, now a grotesque pipe like object with an barrel made from bone and coated in flesh.  There is an biomancer rune embedded in the tooth like trigger.  Uses sharpened bone as an ammo.

use_action.msg: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for close combat

data.description: A sharp bone, you wonder why someone had the trouble to make this.

data.description: A generic copper magic ring.

data.description: A generic silver magic ring.

data.name: magic ring
data.description: A generic gold magic ring.

A thin silver band ring, engraved with two sealed scrolls.  Increases mana capacity somewhat.
A thin gold band ring, engraved with a bound book.  Increases mana capacity moderately.
A thin platinum band ring, engraved with two bound books.  Increases mana capacity greatly.
An ornate silver ring engraved with daggers that conjures three mundane throwing knives on activation.

data.name: eel ring
data.description: A thin silver band ring, depicting an eel coiled on itself.  Allows you to dodge an extra attack per turn.
A thin gold band ring, depicting a bicephalous eel coiled on itself.  Allows you to dodge two extra attacks per turn.
A copper ring that makes you a little stronger when you wear it.
A silver ring that makes you a good bit stronger when you wear it.
A golden ring that makes you surprisingly stronger when you wear it.
A platinum ring that makes you much stronger when you wear it.
A copper ring that makes you a little more agile when you wear it.
A silver ring that makes you a good bit more agile when you wear it.
A golden ring that makes you surprisingly more agile when you wear it.
A platinum ring that makes you much more agile when you wear it.

A silver ring that makes you a good bit more intelligent when you wear it.
A golden ring that makes you surprisingly more intelligent when you wear it.

A silver ring that makes you a good bit more perceptive when you wear it.
A golden ring that makes you eye-openingly more perceptive when you wear it.
A platinum ring that makes you much more perceptive when you wear it.
A copper ring that makes you a little faster when you wear it.
A silver ring that makes you a good bit faster when you wear it.
A golden ring that makes you quite hasty when you wear it.
A platinum ring that makes you much faster when you wear it.
A copper ring that reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
A silver ring that appreciably reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
A golden ring that greatly reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
A platinum ring that vastly reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
A glistening ring holding a small dimensional space inside.  Can store only a little but you can draw items instantly.
A glistening ring holding a small dimensional space inside.  Capable of storing a medium-sized weapon you can draw instantly.

data.name: longsword token
data.description: A large silver coin that, when activated by uttering the word on the back, turns into the item pictured on the front, in this case a longsword.

use_action.msg: You say the command word engraved on the token, and it rapidly grows and morphs into a shiny pristine longsword!

data.description: A large silver coin that, when activated by uttering the word on the back, turns into the item pictured on the front, in this case an arming sword.

use_action.msg: You say the command word engraved on the token, and it rapidly grows and morphs into a shiny pristine arming sword!

data.name: broadsword token
data.description: A large silver coin that, when activated by uttering the word on the back, turns into the item pictured on the front, in this case a broadsword.

data.name: finger firelighter
data.description: This is a small flame you can hold in your hand.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.

data.name: stable spark
data.description: Small electric spark, that does not disappear under your force.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.

data.name: magic lamp
data.description: A magical light source that will light up a small area.

data.name: magic light
data.description: A small magical light that you can read by.
A lightweight but tough shield crafted entirely of magical ice.
A magical slick icy coating on your feet.  While quite fast on flat floors, they make it difficult to move on rough terrain.
A crackling magical warhammer full of lightning to smite your foes with, and of course, to smash things to bits!
Encases your arm and hand in a sheath of crackling magical lightning, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.

data.name: vicious tentacle whip
data.description: A long, writhing, tentacle covered in sharp bonelike blades and spikey protrusions.

data.name: flarewhip
data.description: A long whip made of blue-hot magical flames.  The heat is horrendous when touching an enemy.
A large pouch of tough flesh on your back, filled with tiny tentacles that grasp and hold anything you place inside.  It shifts and adjusts itself to minimize encumbrance.
This is a wicked spear/halberd hybrid entirely created of bone.

data.description: A magically conjured ornate recurve bow of solid flexible wood.  A matching conjured wooden arrow appears when you draw the string back for firing.
A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.
A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.  This is an enhanced version, created by your increased mastery of the spell.
A magically conjured arrow made of twisted wood.
A arrow that looks more like it was grown than carved.  Despite that, it flies straight and true.  It explodes into a mass of entangling vegetation when it hits its target.

use_action.msg: You squeeze the seed in your palm, and it begins to turn to a fine dust.

data.description: A magical seed that can be squeezed to release purifying dust, which can then be used to purify up to a gallon of water.
This handful of fine dust glows with a growing intensity.
A magical powder that can be scattered on growing crops to make them grow faster.
A thin layer of magical ice, covering the entire body.  It doesn't provide much armor, instead dealing significant damage to enemies that try to attack you.
A thin layer of shifting, almost fluid living rock, covering the entire body.

desc: This burn really hurts!

data.description: Ouch, this really smarts!  It'll go away soon, maybe?
An all-encompassing, invisible layer of magical aura that protects you from the environment.

A pulsating club made of bone, stained with an ever-moving blood coating eager to absorb the living.
A leather sling, quivering with energy when in your palm to the point of almost tearing.  A pebble appears when you begin spinning it.

data.name: acid aura

data.name: werewolf aura
data.description: You have become the werewolf.  Boys becoming men, men becoming wolves.

data.name: Black Dragon Shell
data.description: An aura of black and green draconic energy, swirling around your body protecting you and punishing those who strike you.
Claws made from ice, able to freeze on contact while mauling foes.  You, however, feel only a slight chill on your hands.
A summoned magic armor.  It gets shinier and sturdier with each spell level and is affected by your intelligence.
A three-liter container made out of transparent force.  Can be used to store liquids.
This is a summoned mana sword, between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It glows shiny, and its edge is sharper the more spell level and intelligence you have.
A sturdy shell that wraps your body, granting a sturdy defense.
A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  You can feel solar energy radiating from it, and it saturates your body.

use_action.msg: You cover the pocket sun, and now the gap doesn't emit light.

data.description: A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  It is currently covered.

use_action.msg: You remove the cover on the pocket sun, and now the gap emits light again.

data.description: A small ethereal pocket located under your left arm.  You can store your potions here, but it seems it has no real limitations.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, wrapped in ethereal flames.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, emanating frigid cold.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife with wide edge made for throwing, seems unnaturally sharp.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, made of porous substance and covered in dark ooze.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A transparent blade that seems to radiate intent to be thrown.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common hammer.
